prompt_en: A school-life photograph observes students sharing a school day, a small scene of everyday campus life in a university classroom after lessons. The central student is a 21-year-old woman using the supplied portrait as facial and short-hair appearance reference: retain the individual facial proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and fine separated fringe visible in that reference. She presides over a student-council vote about converting an unused room into a shared study lounge. Four classroom desks form a square meeting table; the students occupy three sides, leaving the camera-side edge open. The central student sits on the right, two classmates aged 21 to 24 sit along the far edge, and a fourth student of the same age range keeps the minutes on the left. The two voters each raise one hand above shoulder level. Their raised hands are separate against the plain chalkboard. The chair turns toward them with attentive eyes and the beginning of a pleased smile, one forearm resting on the tabletop and her other hand open toward the voters. Her face is seen in three-quarter view; her short bob moves slightly as she turns. The minute taker writes in an open notebook. A large chalkboard heading reads STUDENT COUNCIL above a simple floor-plan sketch. The full heading occupies a clear band above both raised hands, so each letter remains visible on the board. Stacked lesson books and the classroom window frames establish the ordinary teaching room around this temporary meeting. The central student wears a softly textured navy cardigan over an ivory shirt, with natural skin detail and an easy, unforced presence. Photograph from the open side at seated eye height in a medium-wide horizontal composition: her face and the two raised hands carry the frame, while the notebook and chalkboard remain readable supporting context. Keep the group on a shallow arc at a comparable distance from the lens. Late-afternoon window light crosses their faces softly, with neutral shadows, warm wooden desks and a lived-in documentary texture.
